en: He had to abandon his car in the snow.
zh: 他不得不把车丢弃在雪地里。

m: adj. 抽象的 n. 摘要
en: The concept is too abstract for children.
zh: 这个概念对孩子来说太抽象了。

m: adj. 学术的 n. 学者
en: She has a strong academic background.
zh: 她有很强的学术背景。

en: The car accelerated to overtake the truck.
zh: 汽车加速超过了卡车。

m: adj. 可进入的，易接近的
en: The building is accessible to wheelchair users.
zh: 坐轮椅的人可以进入这栋大楼。

en: She accompanied me to the hospital.
zh: 她陪我去了医院。

en: She accomplished the task ahead of schedule.
zh: 她提前完成了任务。

en: The report gives an accurate picture of the situation.
zh: 这份报告准确地反映了情况。

en: You can achieve your goals through hard work.
zh: 通过努力你可以实现目标。

en: She acquired a good knowledge of French.
zh: 她很好地掌握了法语。

en: Animals must adapt to survive.
zh: 动物必须适应环境才能生存。

en: Make sure you get adequate sleep.
zh: 一定要保证充足的睡眠。

en: It took him a week to adjust to the new job.
zh: 他花了一周才适应新工作。

en: I admire her courage and determination.
zh: 我钦佩她的勇气和决心。

en: He admitted that he was wrong.
zh: 他承认自己错了。

en: The company adopted a new strategy.
zh: 公司采用了新战略。

en: Speaking English is a big advantage in the job market.
zh: 会讲英语在就业市场上是一大优势。

m: v. 提倡 n. 拥护者
en: Many experts advocate a balanced diet.
zh: 许多专家提倡均衡饮食。

en: The weather can affect your mood.
zh: 天气会影响你的情绪。

en: We can't afford a new car this year.
zh: 我们今年买不起新车。

en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
zh: 议程的第一项是预算。

en: The plan has been altered slightly.
zh: 计划做了少许改动。

m: n. 可选方案 adj. 替代的
en: We have no alternative but to wait.
zh: 我们别无选择只能等待。

en: Her ambition is to become a doctor.
zh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生。

en: Scientists analyzed the data carefully.
zh: 科学家们仔细分析了数据。

en: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.
zh: 我们预计明年销量会增长。

en: She was anxious about the exam results.
zh: 她为考试结果感到焦虑。

m: adj. 明显的，显而易见的
en: It was apparent that he knew nothing about it.
zh: 很明显他对此一无所知。

en: The design has great visual appeal.
zh: 这个设计有很大的视觉吸引力。

en: You should apply for the scholarship early.
zh: 你应该尽早申请奖学金。

en: I really appreciate your help.
zh: 我非常感激你的帮助。

m: n. 方法 v. 接近
en: We need a new approach to the problem.
zh: 我们需要用新方法解决这个问题。

en: Wear clothes appropriate for the occasion.
zh: 穿适合场合的衣服。

en: The board approved the plan unanimously.
zh: 董事会一致批准了该计划。

en: They argued about money all evening.
zh: 他们整晚都在为钱争吵。

en: Problems may arise during the project.
zh: 项目期间可能出现问题。

en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
zh: 她把花插进花瓶里。

en: Two teachers assisted with the experiment.
zh: 两位老师协助做这个实验。

en: I assume you have heard the news.
zh: 我想你已经听说这个消息了。

en: The exhibition attracted thousands of visitors.
zh: 展览吸引了成千上万的参观者。

en: Tickets are available at the door.
zh: 门口有票出售。

m: n. 平衡 v. 权衡
en: Try to keep a balance between work and life.
zh: 尽量保持工作与生活的平衡。

en: Language is often a barrier to communication.
zh: 语言常常是交流的障碍。

m: n. 利益 v. 受益
en: Regular exercise benefits your health.
zh: 经常锻炼有益健康。

en: They launched a campaign to protect the river.
zh: 他们发起了一场保护河流的运动。

en: There are three candidates for the position.
zh: 这个职位有三名候选人。

en: The hall has a seating capacity of 500.
zh: 大厅可容纳500人就座。

m: n. 挑战 v. 向…挑战
en: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
zh: 学习一门新语言是个大挑战。

en: Under no circumstances should you give up.
zh: 任何情况下你都不应该放弃。

en: The two teams collaborated on the project.
zh: 两个团队在这个项目上进行了合作。

en: He committed himself to helping the poor.
zh: 他致力于帮助穷人。

en: The local community supported the school.
zh: 当地社区支持这所学校。

en: Compare the two versions and choose the better one.
zh: 比较两个版本，选更好的那个。

en: Twenty teams competed for the title.
zh: 二十支队伍争夺冠军。

en: I can't concentrate with all this noise.
zh: 这么吵我无法集中注意力。

m: v. 进行，指挥 n. 行为
en: They conducted a survey of 1,000 students.
zh: 他们对1000名学生进行了调查。

en: She is confident about passing the exam.
zh: 她有信心通过考试。

en: Don't confuse 'quite' with 'quiet'.
zh: 不要把quite和quiet混淆。

en: The bridge connects the two cities.
zh: 这座桥连接了两座城市。

en: He must face the consequences of his actions.
zh: 他必须面对自己行为的后果。

en: Please consider my suggestion.
zh: 请考虑我的建议。

en: The machine requires constant attention.
zh: 这台机器需要持续照看。

en: Everyone can contribute to the discussion.
zh: 每个人都可以参与讨论。

en: She convinced me that the plan would work.
zh: 她使我确信这个计划可行。

en: Timing is crucial to the plan's success.
zh: 时机对计划的成功至关重要。

en: The city has a rich musical culture.
zh: 这座城市有深厚的音乐文化。

en: The city has changed greatly in the past decade.
zh: 过去十年这座城市变化巨大。

en: The government declared a state of emergency.
zh: 政府宣布进入紧急状态。

en: The mail is delivered twice a day.
zh: 邮件每天投递两次。

en: The study demonstrates the link between diet and health.
zh: 这项研究证明了饮食与健康的联系。

en: Your attitude determines your success.
zh: 你的态度决定你的成功。

en: The company develops educational software.
zh: 这家公司开发教育软件。

en: We need to discuss the matter in detail.
zh: 我们需要详细讨论这件事。

en: The new engine is more efficient.
zh: 新发动机效率更高。

en: We should eliminate unnecessary costs.
zh: 我们应该消除不必要的开支。

en: The school puts great emphasis on reading.
zh: 这所学校非常重视阅读。

en: We encountered several problems on the way.
zh: 我们在路上遇到了几个问题。

en: The university was established in 1851.
zh: 这所大学创建于1851年。

en: Teachers evaluate students' progress each term.
zh: 老师每学期评估学生的进步。

en: There is strong evidence for this theory.
zh: 有有力的证据支持这一理论。
